description: Na(H₂O)₃Ni₄H₃(CO₄)₃ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. The structure consists of one Na(H₂O)₃ ribbon oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction inside a Ni₄H₃(CO₄)₃ framework. In the Na(H₂O)₃ ribbon, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.32 Å) and three longer (2.35 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. In the Ni₄H₃(CO₄)₃ framework, there are two inequivalent Ni sites. In the first Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 40°. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.25 Å. In the second Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 40°. There are three shorter (2.06 Å) and three longer (2.12 Å) Ni-O bond lengths. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.28-1.31 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ni and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Ni and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Ni and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Ni and one C atom.
